title: fix(agents): preserve teams through provider activation and setup recovery
body:
Related: #145712 and #141174.
Follow-up to the [two P1 onboarding findings](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/145712#issuecomment-5644363208).

<details>
<summary>Additional instructions</summary>

This PR uses a branch in openclaw/openclaw, so maintainers can edit it with their existing repository write access.

</details>

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users choosing a team during guided onboarding could pass a provider check but never get their team, or get all four agents while setup still failed to complete. Interrupted setup could also lose the selected coordinator or reject a complete team whose final workspace settings had not yet been written.

## Why This Change Was Made

First-run provider activation keeps runtime metadata in defaults without claiming an agent roster. The existing model-policy migration preserves both unrestricted model selection and a newly approved model in legacy allowlists. Team name collisions and unexpected existing rosters produce explicit failures.

The existing version-1 setup receipt records the normalized coordinator ID. Setup and recovery validate that coordinator, the complete preset roster, delegation, and each member's workspace against the approved parent directory. The receipt remains authoritative across restart, including activation that needs no config write. Recovery reuses the already-approved workspace rather than requiring a later global-default write to have completed. Single-agent workspace equality is preserved.

Consent persistence, terminal handoff, and test initialization were consolidated into their existing owners. No config option, table, schema-version bump, or dependency was added. CHANGELOG.md remains release-owned.

## User Impact

A failed provider check creates no team members. Successful activation can provision the requested team, and interrupted setup resumes its saved coordinator before or after member creation. Choosing Skip still provisions the offline team and explains that provider setup remains necessary. A damaged recorded team cannot silently complete as a single-agent setup or open an invalid coordinator chat.

Existing per-member creation failures can retain members and still require manual repair; this does not introduce automatic adoption or rollback of partial teams. Legacy receipts without a recorded coordinator retain complete-layout recovery detection.

## Evidence

- Latest landing candidate: 289 tests passed across 12 files, including activation, setup, receipt recovery, guided onboarding, classic wizard, memory-import ordering, team creation, and role catalog coverage.
- `node scripts/check-changed.mjs` passed.
- `pnpm check:architecture` passed.
- Formatting and `git diff --check` passed.
- Original independent review: no accepted/actionable findings at P0–P2. Fresh review of the merged landing candidate: no accepted/actionable P0 findings.
- The CLI smoke below also builds the committed source through the supported wrapper. Tests reused the previously built, unchanged bundled-provider artifacts while exercising current source.

Landing validation on `d14280c0cfb5239e59914a20ecf31eaaa844f83f`:

- CI exposed stale wizard prompt and guided receipt fixtures. The fixtures now supply valid initial prompt answers, inject races at the completion boundary, and reuse the existing receipt/config fixture for memory ordering. The original behavior assertions remain intact; production behavior is unchanged by this follow-up.
- Changed checks for the repaired fixtures passed, including typechecking, lint, and dead-export scans. After merging main, direct lint passed for every changed TypeScript file and both tests that newly exceeded 1,000 lines on main. The full runtime and 92 plugin builds passed.
- Main `6e259355b89e390f18a7183249ba964774da60e4` was merged without conflicts. The original commit was retained. The initial CI run also hit the Gateway override failure reproduced on main run [34683883354](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/34683883354/job/103528157521), and an unchanged process-lock timing fixture; neither unrelated owner was edited.

Captured local production-composition output (real activation, provisioning, persisted config, HTTP client and SQLite receipts against a local response fixture):

```text
 ✓ src/commands/onboard-guided.inference.e2e.test.ts > guided onboarding inference composition > advances through a real embedded probe and setup (configured) 6190ms
 ✓ src/commands/onboard-guided.inference.e2e.test.ts > guided onboarding inference composition > advances through a real embedded probe and setup (before-provision) 2199ms
 ✓ src/commands/onboard-guided.inference.e2e.test.ts > guided onboarding inference composition > advances through a real embedded probe and setup (after-members) 2035ms
 ✓ src/commands/onboard-guided.inference.e2e.test.ts > guided onboarding inference composition > advances through a real embedded probe and setup (after-provision) 2240ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  4 passed (4)
```

The interruption cases assert a pending receipt with the saved coordinator, resume setup, and then assert the complete four-member roster, completed receipt, and coordinator workspace handoff. The state suite also closes and reopens the database before reading the saved coordinator. These are process-composition and database-reopen checks; a separate full operating-system process restart was not run during landing.

Maintainer acceptance: the explicit landing order accepts the additive version-1 receipt field, complete-layout detection for legacy receipts, and fail-closed handling of changed team membership, delegation, or workspaces. Partial team creation still requires operator repair; no automatic adoption or rollback is introduced.

The focused regressions first failed on activation-created roster membership, parent/child receipt mismatch, skipped team requests, legacy model visibility, existing-fleet classification, loss of recorded coordinator identity, no-op activation, and interruption immediately after member publication. The provider composition test uses a local HTTP server with real activation, provisioning, persisted config, and SQLite receipts; it also covers interruptions before creation and after setup application.

Isolated CLI smoke exited 0 with `--non-interactive --team --accept-risk --auth-choice skip --no-install-daemon --skip-health --skip-ui --skip-skills --skip-hooks --json` and a temporary workspace. Persisted roster and all role files were verified for coordinator, researcher, writer, and reviewer. The committed-source build passed.
